blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alex Eala’s run with Shaira Rivera in the Asian Games women’s doubles ended in the second round after they bowed out to China’s Jiang Xinyu and Yang Zhaoxuan, 7-5, 6-2, on Wednesday night at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center. Eala and Rivera dug deep in the first set after the Chinese pair cruised to set point, 5-2, but the Filipino tandem never gave up in the next three games to force a deuce at 5-5.
